newsitem.title: USA: Foreland sets Ghost Ranch production.
newsitem.headline: Foreland sets Ghost Ranch production.

text.p: Foreland Corp said Friday the Ghost Ranch 38-45 well will be produced at a rate of about 400 barrels per of oil per day after flowing 470 to 495 barrels daily during a three day production test.
The Ghost Ranch 38-45 well is a westerly offset to the Ghost Ranch 48-35, the discovery for the field, the company said. The 38-45 well has early 50 percent more net pay than the discovery well.
"This well further demonstrates the high production rates which make Nevada oil exploration so exciting and profitable," Foreland said.
Gross daily production from the company's Eagle Springs and Ghost Ranch fields is currently 1,090 barrels, it said.
Foreland noted it has a l00 percent working interest (82-84 percent net revenue interest) in the Eagle Springs field and a 60 percent working interest (51 percent revenue) in the Ghost Ranch field.
Foreland said its net daily production of 720 barrels exceeds its 1996 average daily production by 410 barrels.
The company's gross revenues for 1996 were $2 million.
Foreland said it submitted a permit for another well on the Ghost Ranch structure. The Ghost Ranch 47-35 will be located northeast of the 38-35 well.

The company said it expects the 47-35 will begin drilling within the next few weeks. Foreland has a 60 percent working interest in the Ghost Ranch field and is the operator. Plains Petroleum Operating Co, a subsidiary of Barrett Resources Corp has the remaining 40 percent.
